not_in_the_minute_ledger.note: These boxes were deleted by their finishers or are still live, so no minute line was written. Bounded from run-log first/last clip timestamps and finisher delete times; the two strong-four boxes are projected to their 2-clip runtime, not measured.

what_that_buys: Tier 3 box a (e06 e12 e17) is launched on the measured figure. Box b (e15 e16 e27) is held until box a's first clip is scored: at $1.70 a box both would fit the projection, but spending on the second before the first says anything buys nothing if the arm is a dud, and there is no deadline pressure -- the freeze is Nov 4.
measured_cost_per_box: The strong-four boxes did bring-up, a cold image build, a 49 MB upload, two 50M-step fine-tunes and two evaluations in 110 minutes = $1.25/box, against the $2.25 the estimate used. So a 3-clip Tier 3 box is about $1.70, not $2.25.
